newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain to detail 1998 budget on August 1.
newsitem.headline: Spain to detail 1998 budget on August 1.

text.p: The Spanish government will announce final details of its 1998 budget on August 1 after next week's Cabinet meeting, a government spokesman said on Thursday.

"Friday next week the Economy Minister Rodrigo Rato will be here to give more details of the (new) budget law," spokesman Miguel Angel Rodriguez told a news conference after the regular weekly Cabinet meeting.
Rodriguez said the 1998 budget law would set a target for the central government deficit of 2.0 percent of gross domestic product (GDP) and the public sector deficit at 2.4 percent of GDP.
The Cabinet meeting is usually held on Friday, but this week it was held on Thursday due to a public holiday on Friday.
